name: one_a
intro: A single-stage lock. Disarm the one module to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If there is a red wire, cut the RED wire.
- Otherwise, cut the LAST wire.

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Three wires, left to right: green, red, blue.
